messages:
maya: quick heads-up 1: planning a staggered/cascade enable for velvet-13b:v2 in the 23:30-00:30 UTC window. plan: phased micro at 4% EU -> 4% NA -> scale to 20% each if green. keep a 20m steady between steps.
carlos: ack. proposal: protect enterprise-pro and gov tenants by pinning them to velvet-13b:v1 for the first hour. i'll prepare pinlist.
anya: fallback ordering idea: 1) tenant pin, 2) velvet-13b:v1 (previous stable), 3) ember-6b-quant (cost fallback). note: if regional capacity hits eviction thresholds fall back to nearest-region v1 before global fallbacks.
sre-ops: alert thresholds: immediate rollback if p95 > 1000ms OR error_rate > baseline * 1.8 for 4m. page if p95 > 1300ms. also watch sustained qps drop >15% for 3m. dashboards: https://console/redwood/dashboards/velvet-v2-canary
maya: also adding safety gate: if semantic regression (SMOKE_VELVET_SET) shows hallucination delta > 1.0% abort.
carlos: pin command ready: POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"(enterprise-pro|gov)","model":"velvet-13b:v1","ttl":"1h"} -- will apply 10m before window.
ops-bot: changewindow confirmed. owners: @maya, @carlos.
maya: deploy-bot queue please and attach runbook link and monitors tag 'velvet-cascade-ops'.
deploy-bot: queued: /run deploy catalog enable velvet-13b:v2 --cascade=eu:4,na:4 --scale-to=20 --step-duration=20m --window=2026-05-03T23:30Z-00:30Z --monitors=p50,p95,errors,qps --runbook=https://confluence/redwood/velvet-rollout --note="velvet cascade micro"
anya: rollback play (for oncall):
```
# stop specific region canary (EU only)
/run deploy catalog set-traffic --model=velvet-13b:v2 --regions=eu --percent=0
# full rollback to v1
/run deploy catalog rollback --model=velvet-13b:v2 --to=velvet-13b:v1 --reason="canary-failure"
# pin v1 for 1h for affected tenants
POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"enterprise-pro","model":"velvet-13b:v1","ttl":"1h"}
```
nsre-ops: small note: KV cache warming enabled for velvet v2 pre-cutover to reduce cold p99 spikes; additional cache warming can be toggled per-region if we hit p99 jitter.
carlos: applying pins now. will confirm when propagated.
sre-ops: pin applied and verified in catalog.
maya: preflight checklist: pins in place, smoke eval (SMOKE_VELVET_SET) green, oncall assigned. assigning oncall: @anya primary, @sre-ops backup for 00:30-04:30 UTC watch.
anya: smoke eval PASS. hallucination delta 0.3% vs v1. good to go.
maya: starting EU 4% at +8m to allow pins to propagate. will post +6m snapshot then scale decisions.
deploy-bot: starting EU 4% now. will post status at +6m and at steady.
sre-ops: EU +6m: p50=105ms p95=410ms errors=baseline. no alerts.
anya: advance EU to 20% after steady unless any regressions.
deploy-bot: scaling EU to 20% now.
sre-ops: EU @20% steady: p95=470ms errors slightly up but < threshold. semantic smoke still within delta.
maya: proceeding to start NA 4% now.
deploy-bot: starting NA 4% now. will post +6m snapshot.
sre-ops: NA +6m: p50=120ms p95=520ms errors=baseline. slight tail latency in NA; watching.
carlos: small uptick in customer-side timeouts for a handful of enterprise routes (non-pinned). recommending temporary pin for those selectors until we stabilize.
maya: okay, apply targeted pin for the impacted selectors for 30m and notify their owners. keep global rollout for others.
carlos: applying targeted pin for selectors: {"enterprise-route-A","partner-x"} -> velvet-13b:v1 ttl=30m. done.
sre-ops: continuing watch: NA p95 trending down after targeted pin. no page.
anya: if NA worsens we can do a partial rollback (stop NA canary only) with set-traffic command. otherwise continue to scale.
maya: after 20m steady on NA we'll consider global finalize and update changelog. final handoff to platform for 24h watch.
ops-bot: reminder: please file short release note and update catalog changelog once checks are complete.
maya: noted. post-mortem note: log any selector-specific regressions so we can improve variant routing.
anya: final status: no page, semantic gate passed, targeted pins applied and later removed as stable. marking this rollout green. :tada:
carlos: removing temporary selector pins now; final changelog entry posted.
maya: thanks team. thread closed unless any regressions.
